english.title: Registered person fail to give notice of absence to Care Quality Commission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[service provider]_

of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..),

(C)_[failed to notify the Care Quality Commission of a proposed absence of 28 days or more]_
(D)_[where an emergency had occurred, failed to notify the Care Quality Commission of an absence of 28 days or more within 5 working days of the occurrence]_
(E)_[having been absent for 28 days or more, and notice not having been given to the Care Quality Commission, failed to give notice of the absence forthwith]_
(F)_[having been absent for 28 days or more, and having returned to duty, failed to give notice to the Care Quality Commission not later than 7 days after the date of return]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14 and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
